mapper.update: UPDATE extension_request SET request_status = #{requestStatus}, audit_admin_id = #{auditAdminId}, audit_time = NOW(), audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT er.id, er.student_id AS studentId, su.real_name AS studentName, sp.student_no AS studentNo, er.request_sessions AS requestSessions, er.reason, er.request_status AS status, er.audit_remark AS auditRemark, er.create_time AS createTime FROM extension_request er LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON er.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON su.id = sp.user_id
